name: chatos-project-management
description: Local requirement trees, versioned documents, dependency scopes, frozen plans and Task Runner references for the client-bound project.

interface.shortDescription: 需求、文档、工作项、依赖、规划与执行交接
interface.longDescription: Project-scoped local planning with requirement hierarchy, independent versioned documents, bidirectional dependency scopes, immutable plans and opaque Task Runner references. Project identity and Git stay in the client; runtime status stays in Task Runner.

permissions.reason: Run the local project planning UI and MCP against the same isolated plugin database.
